name: Packing
description: Packing pieces of graded thickness, stacked up until the space is filled.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 8%, #000 8% 16%, transparent 16% 21%, #000 21% 34%, transparent 34% 40%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 4%, transparent 4% 8%, #000 8% 16%, transparent 16% 21%, #000 21% 34%, transparent 34% 40%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
